description: Resilience analysis WDS power outages in the USVI Dataset 080621 is a data set deposited in Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Repository by the authors named in the record. The dataset will include the simulation results from the WNTR analysis of power outages on the US Virgin Islands water distribution system networks. The results include the resilience metrics: modified resilience index, the water service availability, the difference in water, and the tank capacity.
